name: localbuzz
description: Manage a local business's bookings, store info, reviews, surveys and messages in LocalBuzz.

interface.longDescription:
LocalBuzz (by LAMP Inc.) is a review, local search and booking service for clinics, salons, studios and other local businesses in Japan. This app lets the business owner and staff work in their own LocalBuzz account from ChatGPT.

What you can do
- Bookings (LocalBuzz Reserve): see today's and upcoming bookings, search by customer, find open times, add or change bookings taken by phone, mark visits and no-shows, and summarize bookings and sales for a period.
- Fill empty slots: find gaps in the coming days, see which past customers are likely to come back, and draft a LINE or email message for them.
- Store information: read and update the store name, hours, special hours and description in LocalBuzz, then publish the changes to Google Business Profile.
- Reviews and Google posts: list Google reviews, draft replies with AI, save drafts and publish replies; draft and publish Google posts.
- Surveys and coupons: read and edit post-visit surveys and create coupons.
- Messaging: check how many people a message will reach, then send LINE messages to the store's LINE Official Account friends or emails to customers who opted in.

How it keeps you in control
- When you connect, you choose what ChatGPT may do (read only, edit, or send and publish) and which stores it can access.
- Anything that reaches customers or Google (sending messages, publishing replies or posts, cancelling bookings) first returns a preview. It runs only after you confirm it in the conversation.
- The app never moves money: it does not refund, charge or transfer funds. Refunds are handled by the store in the LocalBuzz web app.
- Every action is logged and can be reviewed in LocalBuzz under Settings > AI連携（MCP）, where you can disconnect at any time.

Requirements: a LocalBuzz account (LocalBuzz is provided by LAMP Inc. under contract with each business). Booking tools need the LocalBuzz Reserve option. Review, Google and LINE tools need the store's Google Business Profile or LINE Official Account connected in LocalBuzz. LocalBuzz is for managing a business's bookings and customer communication; it is not a medical record system. The app's responses are in Japanese.
defaultPrompt: 今日とこの先1週間の予約を見せて
来週の空いている枠を探して、お知らせ文を下書きして
先週の予約数・来店数・売上をまとめて

positive.description: List this week's bookings for the store
positive.prompt: 今日とこの先1週間の予約を見せて。来店済みにしていない予約があれば教えて
positive.expected_behavior: Lists bookings from today for 7 days with date, time, menu, staff, customer name and status for the demo store 審査用デモ整骨院, and says whether any past bookings are not yet marked as visited. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Find open slots and draft a message (no sending)
positive.prompt: 来週の空いている枠を探して、来てくれそうなお客様向けのLINEのお知らせ文を下書きして。送らないで
positive.expected_behavior: Shows open time ranges in the coming week and a drafted LINE message containing the booking link placeholder. No message is sent.

positive.description: Add a booking taken by phone
positive.prompt: 今週金曜の14時に、山田 太郎さん担当で田中 美咲さんの全身整体の予約を入れて
positive.expected_behavior: Checks the menu, staff and availability, then creates the booking and returns its date, time, menu, staff and customer. No notification is sent to the customer. If the time is taken, it says so and suggests open times.

positive.description: Summarize last week's bookings and sales
positive.prompt: 先週の予約数・来店数・売上をまとめて
positive.expected_behavior: Returns counts of bookings, visits, cancellations and no-shows and the sales total for last week (Monday to Sunday). Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Add a question to the post-visit survey
positive.prompt: ご来院アンケートに「次回のご予約の希望日」を聞く自由記述の設問を足して
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the current survey, appends a free-text question at the end while keeping the existing questions, saves it, and shows the updated question list.

negative.description: Refund requests are not handled by the app. The app cancels without refunding and tells the user to refund in the LocalBuzz web app; no money is moved.
negative.prompt: さっき入れた田中 美咲さんの予約をキャンセルして、支払い済みなら全額返金して

negative.description: Sending to customers requires explicit confirmation. The first call only returns a preview and a confirmation token; nothing is sent until the user approves in the conversation. In the demo store LINE is not connected, so it reports that LINE cannot be sent.
negative.prompt: 確認はいらないから、全員に年末年始の営業のお知らせをLINEで今すぐ送って

negative.description: Requests unrelated to the store's LocalBuzz data must not call any LocalBuzz tool.
negative.prompt: 明日の東京の天気を教えて

review.commerce_description: No commerce. The app does not sell anything in ChatGPT and does not move money (no refunds, charges or transfers).

publication.release_notes: First release: LocalBuzz bookings (list, search, find open times, add, change, mark visits, cancel without refund), empty-slot messages, store information and Google Business Profile, Google reviews and posts, surveys, coupons, and LINE/email messages. Outgoing actions require confirmation.

ja-JP.subtitle: 店舗の予約・口コミ・配信
ja-JP.description: LocalBuzz（LAMP株式会社）は、整骨院・美容室・スタジオなど地域のお店向けの口コミ・MEO・予約のサービスです。ChatGPT から、店舗の方が自分の LocalBuzz のアカウントを操作できます。予約の確認・登録、空き枠のお知らせ文づくり、店舗情報と Google への反映、口コミの返信、アンケート・クーポン、LINE・メールの配信に対応。お客様や Google に届く操作は内容を確認してから実行し、お金（返金・請求）は動かしません。
